name: What are the typical costs involved in ADU construction in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs involved in ADU construction in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of ADU construction in Los Angeles varies significantly based on factors such as size, complexity, materials, and site conditions. A basic garage conversion might start around $100,000, while a new detached ADU can range from $150,000 to over $300,000. These figures typically include design, permits, materials, and labor. Utility connections, foundation work, and high-end finishes can also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU construction costs in Los Angeles vary widely, from around $100,000 for a garage conversion to $150,000-$300,000+ for a new detached unit, depending on size and features.
